=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:174-177 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The check `if [[ "${ue_post_out}" != *"state=success outcome=posted"* ]]; then` reads the stdout of review_head_gate_post_status, which runs gh api directly and does not echo "outcome=posted".
  WHY: The exemption function would always log "outcome=skipped reason=post_failed", even when the status post succeeds, so the gate fails closed when it should not. The source severity was BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash all disputed this finding: they report that scripts/review_head_gate.sh:36-37 prints `state=${status_state} outcome=posted`.
- tests/test_review_head_gate.py:481 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In test_review_tail_calls_the_exemption_before_its_updater_exit, the anchor `text.index('^auto/update-workflows-[0-9a-f]{12}$ ]]; then')` is out of date after the merge from main, and str.index raises ValueError when it cannot find the substring.
  WHY: The test would raise an unhandled exception, so CI would fail on every head. The source severity was BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash all disputed this finding: they report that the anchor now sits at line 493 and uses `(-r[2-5])?$`.
